integrity: The complete defining face sets, acyclic Morse matchings, and mod-two checks are regenerated from a standalone standard-library Python verifier. Independent external validation and audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This exact finite classification concerns only Paley(13); no result for higher Paley orders or for arbitrary conference graphs is asserted. The published Alexander-duality theorem is not new; unindexed equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: Dual sphere-wedge homotopy of the Paley-thirteen neighborhood and dominance complexes
